name: ohm-sweet-ohm
description: Public API to find reusable electronic circuit blocks and explore their variants

scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm lint:md && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:coverage && pnpm doc:coverage
scripts.catalogue:render: docker build -q -t ohm-sweet-ohm-renderer docker/renderer && mkdir -p build && docker run --rm -u "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD:/repo" -w /repo --entrypoint scripts/render-catalogue.sh ohm-sweet-ohm-renderer
